## Week menu
**שבוע <n>**

For each chapter that has units in this week, a bold line `פרק <number> · <chapter title>`,
then its units as bullets: `- **<shortcut>** · <unit title>`.

## Navigation
- "חזור" or "תפריט" → back one level (week menu → welcome).
- "הבא" → the next unit in this week (in catalog order) after the last one completed.

## Running a unit
